verdict.rationale: Salesforce's AgentExchange page says users can "find, evaluate, and plug in trusted third-party agents, sub-agents, and MCP servers directly within Agentforce Builder", and the Sales Cloud pricing page lists "Access to AgentExchange". That ties MCP-client capability to the Sales Cloud offering, but only through Agentforce rather than as a documented Sales Cloud feature. The official MCP server (salesforcecli/mcp) belongs to the separate server-role story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: setup documentation for registering arbitrary or custom MCP servers, any detail on how agents call MCP tools inside Sales Cloud workflows, clarity on whether this requires separate Agentforce licensing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
